correctness.rationale: For each n=2,...,7 the exact source set contains 3*2^(n-1) words, every single-deletion shadow has n distinct outputs, and compatible pairs are exactly disjoint shadows. verify_exact.cpp executes exhaustive maximum-clique branch-and-bound with a valid greedy proper-coloring upper bound and returns maxima 1,3,4,8,12,22 (1,526,900 recursion calls for n=7), checking its witnessing cliques. Independent incidence-based mixed-integer optimization proves identical optima with optimal status. The pure-Python verifier reconstructs all source/output incidences and checks every rational primal and dual inequality and equal objectives, proving fractional optima 3/2,3,9/2,42/5,27/2,99/4. The n=1 case is immediate. There is no extrapolation beyond n=7; correctness rests on the supplied finite algorithms.
risks: The proof of integer upper bounds is finite executable enumeration rather than a short handwritten inequality.
No independent external mathematical validation has been performed.

value.rationale: A natural design requirement, forbidden homopolymer runs of length two, is combined with unlocated single deletion. The exact six-versus-seven-symbol threshold M_6=12<16<=M_7=22 is a useful finite four-bit design cutoff, and the exactly certified P_7-M_7=11/4 quantifies a genuine integrality obstruction for the classical fractional shadow-packing method. Neither conclusion is an automatic numerical consequence of the general literature bounds. This is a natural short-block benchmark; no general larger-length contribution is claimed.
risks: The directly evaluated language is ternary rather than four-letter DNA.
Application to streaming synchronization and longer blocks is unproved.
